channel.title: The Ghanaian Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Ghanaian Times (ghanaiantimes.com.gh)

item.title: Damage to submarine cables threatens Ghana’s digital economy - ASGOC - Ghanaian Times
item.description: Ghana’s digital economy is at risk as damage to submarine cables continues to rise, threatening over 95 per cent of the country’s international communications.

item.title: GCNM inducts 552 professionals - Ghanaian Times
item.description: The Ghana College of Nurses and Midwives (GCNM) has inducted about 552 critical health professionals into the College to promote academic excellence and improve healthcare delivery.

item.title: NPA reaffirms commitment to consumer protection at 2026 World Consumer Rights Day Celebration - Ghanaian Times
item.description: The Chief Executive of the National Petroleum Authority (NPA), Godwin Kudzo Tameklo Esq., has reaffirmed the Authority’s commitment to protecting consumer interests and ensuring the delivery of safe, quality petroleum products in Ghana’s downstream sector.

item.title: NPP criticises Mahama Government, claims economic gains are being reversed - Ghanaian Times
item.description: The opposition New Patriotic Party (NPP) has criticised the administration of President John Dramani Mahama, accusing it of reversing economic gains and failing to improve the living conditions of Ghanaians.

item.title: Lordina Mahama attends Global Summit on Children’s Digital Future in Washington - Ghanaian Times
item.description: The First Lady of Ghana, Lordina Dramani Mahama, is in Washington, D.C. to participate in the Fostering the Future Together Global Coalition Summit.

item.title: Police arrest 77 suspects in anti-drug operation in Tamale and Savelugu - Ghanaian Times
item.description: The Northern Regional Police Command has arrested seventy-seven people in a major anti-drug operation carried out in the Tamale Metropolis and Savelugu Municipality.

item.title: Government moves to protect jobs as Damang mine lease nears expiry - Ghanaian Times
item.description: The Ministry of Lands and Natural Resources has assured Ghanaians that it is taking steps to protect jobs and sustain operations at the Damang Mine as the current lease held by Abosso Goldfields Limited, a subsidiary of Goldfields Limited, expires on April 18, 2026.

item.title: Lincoln University withdraws president Mahama’s honorary doctorate over LGBTQ+ stance - Ghanaian Times
item.description: The Government of Ghana has expressed disappointment after Lincoln University withdrew plans to confer an honorary doctorate on President John Dramani Mahama during his visit to the United States.

item.title: President Mahama Leads Wreath-Laying Ceremony in Honour of Enslaved Africans - Ghanaian Times
item.description: President John Dramani Mahama led a solemn wreath-laying ceremony at the African Burial Ground National Monument in Lower Manhattan, New York, paying tribute to the memory of nearly 20,000 Africans laid to rest at the historic site.

item.title: President Mahama Addresses High-Level Event on Reparatory Justice at the United Nations - Ghanaian Times
item.description: Photos from the High-Level Event on Reparatory Justice for the trafficking of enslaved Africans and the racialised chattel enslavement of African people, convened at the United Nations Headquarters, New York.
